title: ObjectGenericDAE: an object coupling ODE2, ODE1 and algebraic coordinates, linear by matrices and nonlinear by user functions
author: Claude-JG
description: An object on ODE2 nodes, ODE1 nodes and algebraic coordinates of its own, with the linear equations M q_tt + D q_t + K q + E y + C_q^T lambda = f, y_t + C_y^T lambda = A y + B q + B_t q_t + g, C_q q + C_y y = c0, and user functions for the mass matrix, the ODE2 forces, the ODE1 right-hand side and the constraints, each with the arguments (mbs, t, itemNumber, q, q_t, y, ..., parameters) of the existing user items, parameters a vector of the item as in ObjectUserBody; the Jacobians by a jacobianUserFunction or the one-pass derivative of a symbolic recording, never by numerical differences (#3101). Exudyn's implicit solver needs the coupling blocks between ODE2 and ODE1, the explicit solver both kinds in every stage and algebraic equations only where they can be eliminated. The general form of SymbolicSystemBase; the generic object of #1104.
